brief:
Today, Monday 28 September, is Pull A. It is the first night of Meso 3, a four-week building block, so the light deload week is over and sets go back to full. Your trainers set every lift tonight from your last hard Pull A on 20 September, not from the deload.

The one real change is the deadlift. 255 lb has come up short of 5 reps on your last two hard nights, so tonight is 235 for 5, then 245 for 5 on three sets. When 245 goes for 6 on every set, 255 comes back. Everything else holds its weight and asks for reps: pulldown 93 with 10 on the first two sets; the row as a one-arm dumbbell row with the 27.5 kg dumbbell for 10 on all four sets; dumbbell curls with the 12.5 kg dumbbells on all three sets this time; hammer curls at 36 on all three sets; face pulls at 27, trying for 14 on the first set. If tonight's gym has different machines than 20 September's, log what you actually used and the trainers will reset from it.

No pain or soreness shows anywhere in your notes. Two small things: a few sets from Push A on 25 September were typed in afterwards (the rope pushdown two days later), so they were not used to raise any weight. And step on a scale: your last weigh-in was 207 lb on 23 August, 36 days ago, with the show 154 days out. A 20-minute easy walk on a rest day would also help.

overrides.reason: 255 fell short of 5 reps on your two last hard nights (4 and 4 on 10 Sept, 3 and 3 on 20 Sept); 245 gave you 5 on 20 Sept, so the top sets drop 10 lb to 245 for 5 until 245 goes for 6 on every set.
You got 93 for 9 on all three sets on 20 Sept; the weight stays at 93 until all three sets reach 10.
You did this slot as a one-arm dumbbell row with the 27.5 kg dumbbell for 10 on three sets on 20 Sept; tonight is the same dumbbell on all four sets.
On 20 Sept you curled 12.5 kg for 10 on two sets but did the third at 8 kg; all three sets at 12.5 kg for 10 come before 15 kg.
36 for 12, 12, then 35 for 11 on 20 Sept; all three sets go at 36 tonight, and when all three hit 12 the weight goes up 5 lb.
27 for 13 on every set on 15, 20 and 23 Sept; the weight stays and the goal is one more rep on the first set.

dissent.progression: cut the top sets to 245 for 5
dissent.recovery: hold, no top set above 255 until 5 reps there
dissent.why: Both seats agree 255 is not earned; the cut stays under recovery's 255 ceiling and matches two straight nights of missed reps, so it is the safer version of the same read.
Recovery named no weight, and 93 for 9 on every set has not reached the top of the range, so there is nothing earned to push on.

dissent.progression: hold the 27.5 kg dumbbell on all four sets
dissent.why: The fourth set has never been done at 27.5 kg, and recovery named no heavier weight; filling the full slot comes first.

dissent.progression: hold 12.5 kg on all three sets
dissent.why: The third set on 20 Sept was at 8 kg, so three sets at 12.5 kg have never been done; recovery named no weight.
Only two of three sets reached 12 at 36 on 20 Sept, and recovery named no weight, so the step is not earned yet.
